Говорит Морган — Фрэнсис Морган. Мистер Бэском уехал в свою контору не более пяти минут назад. Когда он приедет, скажите ему, что я выехал к нему в контору и отстану от него не больше чем на пять минут. Это важно. Скажите ему, что я в пути. Благодарю. До свидания.", "source_sha256": "889650c8939a0f843e87703a70e8431dac2fdc1dcf73ee041884a7800e150dcd", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u026-r0014", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "3fa1c66b48ee0ce7b09f5c7fbdb7922bbe27a8cda5ddd061f8b8a34bfcfc5f6a"}, {"source_id": "ru78-u026-r0015", "target": "Вполне естественно, что, когда ей ещё предстояло показать все чудеса большого дома, Королева не скрыла своего разочарования, услышав от Фрэнсиса, что ему надо немедленно ехать в место, называемое Уолл-стрит.", "source_sha256": "3ea166645edb526c8d50c9231cda266b4f8c955c105e582b7645290989572c14", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u026-r0015", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "e8f2c3b9ec9de1b61ff622c9b8cb95d3f8418c1ba6d63b2dbfecadaf57d79b20"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u026-r0016", "tag": "p", "text": "“What is it,” she asked, with a pout of displeasure, “that drags you away from me like a slave?”", "sha256": "3e99178984b2f84dcb62f11d5f161296e19695fa88a78811769dffbe7be98143", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2221]", "source_html": "

“What is it,” she asked, with a pout of displeasure, “that drags you away from me like a slave?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0017", "tag": "p", "text": "“It is business——and very important,” he told her with a smile and a kiss.", "sha256": "c75c96df9a662d9ac075f34a6b72f4211588db0fe1c4fdbbd4ab87da68718ee3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2222]", "source_html": "

“It is business——and very important,” he told her with a smile and a kiss.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0018", "tag": "p", "text": "“And what is Business that it should have power over you who are a king? Is business the name of your god whom all of you worship as the Sun God is worshipped by my people?”", "sha256": "35e7fc69d483c7669515609bfb038b5fca5ff533ab4ee1121cc1f30278f592fe", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2223]", "source_html": "

“And what is Business that it should have power over you who are a king? Is business the name of your god whom all of you worship as the Sun God is worshipped by my people?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0019", "tag": "p", "text": "He smiled at the almost perfect appositeness of her idea, saying:", "sha256": "8893b65a856b39132dd87ae654ede40ced76c8a8a93c1f37ea2917de92275130", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2224]", "source_html": "

He smiled at the almost perfect appositeness of her idea, saying:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0020", "tag": "p", "text": "“It is the great American god. Also, is it a very terrible god, and when it slays it slays terribly and swiftly.”", "sha256": "aa2fd74f2342a9ad19a0219f87e03d106b2494f65e7994192a9e63005a038acb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2225]", "source_html": "

“It is the great American god. Also, is it a very terrible god, and when it slays it slays terribly and swiftly.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0021", "tag": "p", "text": "“And you have incurred its displeasure?” she queried.", "sha256": "c426254a84340c6e35140b820791879c9e48d13a0d93140bd2055656c99a668f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2226]", "source_html": "

“And you have incurred its displeasure?” she queried.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0022", "tag": "p", "text": "“Alas, yes, though I know not how. I must go to Wall Street——”", "sha256": "5c62140c48c2b20ab10fbf371836999841a083d151bb47c7af1dca79469d8dbf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2227]", "source_html": "

“Alas, yes, though I know not how. I must go to Wall Street——”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0023", "tag": "p", "text": "“Which is its altar?” she broke in to ask.", "sha256": "cf5dfe1b349b73655caf5d87b508dec9758d07539d5e5a853b48c53a6f523616", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2228]", "source_html": "

“Which is its altar?” she broke in to ask.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0024", "tag": "p", "text": "“Which is its altar,” he answered, “and where I must find out wherein I have offended and wherein I may placate and make amends.”", "sha256": "112682844a8721cac76e20bbe8c2ea3385a7b4fb946544c03cefdb9e561b6715", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2229]", "source_html": "

“Which is its altar,” he answered, “and where I must find out wherein I have offended and wherein I may placate and make amends.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0025", "tag": "p", "text": "His hurried attempt to explain to her the virtues and functions of the maid he had wired for from Colon, scarcely interested her, and she broke him off by saying that evidently the maid was similar to the Indian women who had attended her in the Valley of Lost Souls, and that she had been accustomed to personal service ever since she was a little girl learning English and Spanish from her mother in the house on the lake.", "sha256": "32b2cdd77b5e296f3b041f55fa2ccf6d492e8a28cc1ce714cea012af868734d0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2230]", "source_html": "

His hurried attempt to explain to her the virtues and functions of the maid he had wired for from Colon, scarcely interested her, and she broke him off by saying that evidently 238the maid was similar to the Indian women who had attended her in the Valley of Lost Souls, and that she had been accustomed to personal service ever since she was a little girl learning English and Spanish from her mother in the house on the lake.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0026", "tag": "p", "text": "But when Francis caught up his hat and kissed her, she relented and wished him luck before the altar.", "sha256": "ac3dbbccaac2d7754c1ff01640ab7494f3929e167a4f0f82bba1fe45c7cbd883", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2231]", "source_html": "

But when Francis caught up his hat and kissed her, she relented and wished him luck before the altar.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0027", "tag": "p", "text": "After several hours of amazing adventures in her own quarters, where the maid, a Spanish-speaking Frenchwoman, acted as guide and mentor, and after being variously measured and gloated over by a gorgeous woman who seemed herself a queen and who was attended by two young women, and who, in the Queen’s mind, was without doubt summoned to serve her and Francis, she came back down the grand stairway to investigate the library with its mysterious telephones and ticker.", "sha256": "4fb620cf3b6051e36cf625299cc8f8f348d5bddf1e51e040ed69bda77544f697", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2232]", "source_html": "

After several hours of amazing adventures in her own quarters, where the maid, a Spanish-speaking Frenchwoman, acted as guide and mentor, and after being variously measured and gloated over by a gorgeous woman who seemed herself a queen and who was attended by two young women, and who, in the Queen’s mind, was without doubt summoned to serve her and Francis, she came back down the grand stairway to investigate the library with its mysterious telephones and ticker.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0028", "tag": "p", "text": "Long she gazed at the ticker and listened to its irregular chatter. But she, who could read and write English and Spanish, could make nothing of the strange hieroglyphics that grew miraculously on the tape. Next, she explored the first of the telephones. Remembering how Francis had listened, she put her ear to the transmitter. Then, recollecting his use of the receiver, she took it off its hook and placed it to her ear. The voice, unmistakably a woman’s, sounded so near to her that in her startled surprise she dropped the receiver and recoiled. At this moment, Parker, Francis’ old valet, chanced to enter the room. She had not observed him before, and, so immaculate was his dress, so dignified his carriage, that she mistook him for a friend of Francis rather than a servitor——a friend similar to Bascom who had met them at the station with Francis’ machine, ridden inside with them as an equal, yet departed with Francis’ commands in his ears which it was patent he was to obey.", "sha256": "b381b37e0dcafa9109b9bff056793ee30be44cb3dd056716edb725d170e0843e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2233]", "source_html": "

Long she gazed at the ticker and listened to its irregular chatter. But she, who could read and write English and Spanish, could make nothing of the strange hieroglyphics that grew miraculously on the tape. Next, she explored the first of the telephones. Remembering how Francis had listened, she put her ear to the transmitter. Then, recollecting his use of the receiver, she took it off its hook and placed it to her ear. The voice, unmistakably a woman’s, sounded so near to her that in her startled surprise she dropped the receiver and recoiled. At this moment, Parker, Francis’ old valet, chanced to enter the room. She had not observed him before, and, so immaculate was his dress, so dignified his carriage, that she mistook him for a friend of Francis rather than a servitor——a friend similar to Bascom who had met them at the station with Francis’ machine, ridden inside with them as an equal, yet departed with Francis’ commands in his ears which it was patent he was to obey.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0029", "tag": "p", "text": "At sight of Parker’s solemn face she laughed with embarrassment and pointed inquiringly to the telephone. Solemnly he picked up the receiver, murmured “A mistake,” into the transmitter, and hung up. In those several seconds the Queen’s thought underwent revolution. No god’s nor spirit’s voice had been that which she had heard, but a woman’s voice.", "sha256": "31b3c462a2d0ac11faa80ef8dfe18d16c570ba999f00a9e47bd329ce7345e6a3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2234]", "source_html": "

At sight of Parker’s solemn face she laughed with embarrassment and pointed inquiringly to the telephone. Solemnly he picked up the receiver, murmured “A mistake,” into the transmitter, and hung up. In those several seconds the Queen’s thought underwent revolution. No god’s nor spirit’s voice had been that which she had heard, but a woman’s voice.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0030", "tag": "p", "text": "“Where is that woman?” she demanded.", "sha256": "9fedd855dc43df15c7b9c4f2ddeb450c474bca0a275c6bcee2a71b8f18654d67", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2235]", "source_html": "

“Where is that woman?” she demanded.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0031", "tag": "p", "text": "Parker merely stiffened up more stiffly, assumed a solemner expression, and bowed.", "sha256": "6d2b2248b9128314209510784f41b2178e9f93e764ac51fc41aa3a8ec46b48c0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2236]", "source_html": "

Parker merely stiffened up more stiffly, assumed a solemner expression, and bowed.
